title: Past Participle: Regular dan Irregular
subtitle: Menguasai V3 untuk present perfect
objectives: Membedakan past participle regular dan irregular
Menghafal past participle irregular yang sering muncul di berita
Menggunakan past participle dalam kalimat present perfect

stages.name: Pembuka
stages.teacher_script: Selamat pagi! Kemarin kita belajar struktur present perfect. Siapa bisa beri satu contoh kalimat present perfect? Bagus. Hari ini kita lanjutkan dengan past participle, yaitu bentuk kata kerja ketiga (V3) yang dipakai di present perfect. Ada kata kerja regular yang tinggal tambah -ed, dan ada irregular yang harus dihafal. Coba sebutkan satu kata kerja yang kalian tahu. 'Go'? Bagaimana past participle-nya? Itulah yang akan kita pelajari. Rencana: kita pelajari daftar past participle regular dan irregular, lalu berlatih memakainya di present perfect.
stages.instructions: Sapa murid dan minta satu contoh present perfect kemarin. Tanyakan satu kata kerja dan past participle-nya. Jelaskan tujuan: belajar past participle.

stages.name: Teori
stages.content:
## Apa Itu Past Participle (V3)?

**Past participle** adalah bentuk ketiga dari kata kerja, dipakai di **present perfect** dan **passive voice**. Ada dua jenis: regular dan irregular.

## Kata Kerja Regular

Kata kerja regular membentuk V3 dengan menambahkan **-ed** pada bentuk dasar (sama seperti past simple).

| Bentuk dasar (V1) | Past simple (V2) | Past participle (V3) | Arti |
|---|---|---|---|
| announce | announced | announced | mengumumkan |
| destroy | destroyed | destroyed | menghancurkan |
| injure | injured | injured | melukai |
| rescue | rescued | rescued | menyelamatkan |
| report | reported | reported | melaporkan |
| broadcast | broadcasted | broadcasted | menyiarkan |

## Kata Kerja Irregular

Kata kerja irregular memiliki bentuk V3 khusus yang wajib dihafal.

| V1 | V2 | V3 | Arti |
|---|---|---|---|
| write | wrote | written | menulis |
| speak | spoke | spoken | berbicara |
| give | gave | given | memberi |
| find | found | found | menemukan |
| hit | hit | hit | melanda |
| send | sent | sent | mengirim |
| build | built | built | membangun |
| take | took | taken | mengambil |
| see | saw | seen | melihat |
| do | did | done | melakukan |

## Contoh dalam Present Perfect

- A journalist **has written** a new report. (write -> written)
- The president **has given** an interview. (give -> given)
- Rescue teams **have arrived**. (arrive -> arrived, regular)
- They **haven't found** all the victims. (find -> found)
- **Has** the government **announced** the result? (announce -> announced)

## Tips Mengingat Irregular Verbs

- Hafalkan per kelompok yang mirip: write-wrote-written, give-gave-given, take-took-taken.
- Buat kalimat present perfect untuk setiap kata: 'She has written...'
- Ulangi dengan pasangan: satu sebut V1, satu sebut V3.

> **Hindari:** memakai V2 (past simple) di present perfect. Salah: 'She has wrote a report.' Benar: 'She has written a report.'

> **Catatan:** Beberapa kata V2 dan V3 sama (find-found-found, send-sent-sent). Hati-hati membedakan.

## Mini-dialogue

A: What has the journalist done?
B: She has written a report about the storm.
A: Have they found the victims?
B: No, they haven't found them yet.
key_points: Past participle (V3) adalah bentuk ketiga kata kerja, dipakai di present perfect.
Kata kerja regular: V3 dengan menambah -ed (announce -> announced).
Kata kerja irregular: V3 khusus yang dihafal (write -> written, give -> given).
Beberapa kata V2 dan V3 sama (find-found-found, send-sent-sent).
Hindari memakai V2 di present perfect (has wrote -> has written).
Hafalkan irregular verbs per kelompok yang mirip.
Buat kalimat present perfect untuk setiap kata irregular.

vocabulary.example_en: I read the news every morning.
A journalist has written a new report.
vocabulary.example_id: Seorang wartawan telah menulis laporan baru.

vocabulary.example_en: The journalist has spoken to the public.
vocabulary.example_id: Wartawan itu telah berbicara kepada publik.

vocabulary.example_en: She has written an article about the storm.
vocabulary.example_id: Dia telah menulis artikel tentang badai itu.

vocabulary.example_en: The election result has been announced.
The government has announced a new policy.
The storm has destroyed many houses.
Three earthquakes have hit the region this month.
vocabulary.example_id: Tiga gempa bumi telah melanda wilayah itu bulan ini.

vocabulary.example_en: Three people were injured in the accident.
vocabulary.example_id: Tiga orang terluka dalam kecelakaan itu.

vocabulary.example_en: They haven't found all the victims yet.
Rescue teams have arrived in the area.
vocabulary.example_id: Tim penyelamat telah tiba di daerah itu.

vocabulary.example_en: The government has announced the result.

stages.name: Latihan
stages.instructions:
1) **Drill (5 menit):** Guru menyebut V1, murid sebutkan V3 (write -> written).
2) **Fill-in-the-blank (5 menit):** Lengkapi 8 kalimat present perfect dengan V3 yang benar.
3) **Pair work (4 menit):** Tanyakan-jawab 'What has she/he done?' memakai V3.
4) **Role play (4 menit):** Dua murid memeragakan wartawan dan editor membahas berita.
5) **Error correction (2 menit):** Perbaiki 3 kalimat salah (mis. 'She has wrote' -> 'She has written').

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.en: What is the past participle of 'write'?

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.en: Good. Make a present perfect sentence with 'written'.
dialogue.id: Bagus. Buat kalimat present perfect dengan 'written'.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.en: A journalist has written a report about the storm.
dialogue.id: Seorang wartawan telah menulis laporan tentang badai itu.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.en: The president has given an interview about the policy.
dialogue.id: Presiden telah memberikan wawancara tentang kebijakan itu.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.en: Excellent. What is the V3 of 'find'?

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.en: They haven't found all the victims yet.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.en: Correct this: 'She has wrote a report.'
dialogue.id: Perbaiki ini: 'She has wrote a report.'

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.en: It should be 'She has written a report.'

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.en: Because 'wrote' is V2; we need V3 'written' in present perfect.
dialogue.id: Karena 'wrote' itu V2; kita perlu V3 'written' di present perfect.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.en: Perfect. Last: give the V3 of 'take'.

stages.name: Penutup
stages.teacher_script: Hebat! Hari ini kalian sudah belajar past participle (V3) untuk present perfect. Mari kita ingat: regular tambah -ed, irregular dihafal. Coba saya tanya: V3 dari 'write'? Benar, 'written'. V3 dari 'find'? Tepat, 'found'. Untuk PR, hafalkan 15 kata kerja irregular beserta V3-nya, dan tulis 8 kalimat present perfect memakai kata-kata itu. Pertemuan berikutnya kita akan belajar time markers khas present perfect seperti 'just', 'already', 'yet'. Sampai jumpa!
stages.instructions: Tegaskan perbedaan regular dan irregular V3. Berikan 1-2 pertanyaan pemahaman. Beri PR menghafal 15 irregular verbs dan menulis 8 kalimat.
